detect_language_from_path returns None for dotfile .gitignore (no standard extension)

```go title="Go"

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	result := tspack.DetectLanguageFromPath(`.gitignore`)

}
```
